title: Changelog snapshot composites and before/after UI callouts for release blog
creator: Elena Park
description: Create a small image pack and a set of composite screenshots for the upcoming release blog/changelog. Focus: concise before/after comparisons for three UI surfaces (Quickstart onboarding flow, Console > Model Rollouts, and Console > Cost Insights) plus single-frame feature callouts that can be used inline in the blog, press kit, and docs. Deliver both static and lightweight animated variants (300–600ms morph/fade) optimized for web and social. Include localized variants for EN/DE/FR and a11y-friendly alt copy and contrast-checked overlays.
acceptance_criteria: Master Figma file with annotated frames for each asset and export-ready slices
PNG exports at 1200x630 (social), 1400x800 (hero), and 800x450 (inline) plus SVG callouts where possible
Three before/after composites: onboarding-welcome, rollouts-canary, cost-breakdown-kv. Each has labeled arrows and short caption text baked into the image and a separate caption-only file.
Two animated GIF/WebP variants per composite (lightweight, <150KB targeted for social) with reduced frame count and optimized palette
Alt text and short description strings provided for i18n team for EN/DE/FR
Sign-off from PM (Liam O'Connor) and Engineering reviewer (Ava Patel) confirming UI accuracy
Files uploaded to Drive under /Marketing/ReleaseAssets/2026-03 and linked in ticket
assets: callout_icon_set.svg - 8x icons used in callouts (token, latency, cost, rollout)
changelog_onboarding_hero_1400x800.jpg - hero image with subtle overlay
onboarding_micro_animation_600ms.webp - lightweight morph for social preview
captions_en.txt - short sentences for each image (used in blog alt/descriptions)
export_specifications: Static PNGs: export sRGB, 8-bit, no metadata, background flattened, progressive disabled
SVGs: cleaned IDs, paths expanded, no embedded fonts. Separate color tokens in CSS variables file
Animated WebP: loop 1, 8-bit palette optimization, target <150KB for 1200x630
Naming: lowercase, hyphen-delimited, release date prefix optional (2026-03)
Contrast: all overlay text meets 4.5:1 against background according to WCAG AA
design_notes: Primary aesthetic should align with Redwood brand: warm slate background (#0F1720 tone), high-contrast token accents (teal for positive, amber for warnings). For before/after, use a subtle desaturation for the 'before' frame and a slightly warmer, higher-saturation 'after' frame so the improvement reads at a glance. Use arrow callouts with 2px stroke and 8px rounded corners. Keep labels concise (max 6 words). For the onboarding flow, show the 'Start' button progression and the new inline guidance chip. For rollouts, visualize percentage traffic slider and a green feathered canary segment. For cost insights, show sample per-token breakdown with KV cache savings highlighted in teal. Include a compact version suitable for small blog cards where callouts are stacked vertically.
